ambient_events: The bed's black silk catches the light and lets it go reluctantly.
The wall screen shifts through a muted feed, painting the room in slow colour.
Something expensive and floral hangs in the air, just short of cloying.
description: Cyd's suite, in the bow end of the main deck. A low black-silk bed faces the raked glass over the bow, the bar holds things that aren't on any menu, and a wall of screen shows anything the ship can reach. One wall is all mirrored wardrobe, so the room looks twice its size. The only way out is the hatch (SOUTH) to the foyer.

window.description: A window with a bad seal, letting in a draught and a slice of whatever the weather is doing.
window.name: the window

name: Echelon — Owner's Suite
